mentions.name: Potatoverse
mentions.description: A platform for running web apps, distributed as a single static binary backed by SQLite. It currently supports Lua as the scripting runtime, with WebAssembly (WASM) support planned for the future. A demo instance is available online.

mentions.name: potatoverse
mentions.description: App platform where apps are packaged like an APK but as an spk.zip containing a server.lua backend and HTML/JS/CSS served for the frontend. The platform provides file storage, namespaced/scoped SQLite database access, auth, and user management, with Lua support now and WASM planned, all running in a single static Go binary.
